items.title: NASA Puts Google’s Gemma Large Language Model in Orbit
items.summary: The viability of orbital data centers hosting the largest and most capable large language models (LLMs) remains hotly contested. But enormous deployments that require thousands of GPUs aren’t the only way LLMs might prove useful in space.
